facts.text: Evan was married last week, as indicated by the image of a bride and groom kissing in front of a tree.

evidence.quote: Been up and down lately, got married last week - how about you?
Hey Evan! Long time no see, how's it going?
That's awesome, Evan! Finding that kind of connection must feel really liberating.

facts.text: Evan expressed belief in love at first sight, describing it as a feeling that 'time stopped' and 'a spark lit inside me.'

evidence.quote: I totally believe in it. It was like time stopped and I felt like a spark lit inside me - it was so right.
I was in love with her at first sight!
Do you believe in love at first sight?
